headline: **MLB Daily Recap**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels fell to the Baltimore Orioles 3-1, with Tyler O'Neill hitting his eighth home run of the season. The New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, led by Luis Torrens' 3-hit, 4-RBI performance. The Cincinnati Reds edged the Athletics 5-4, with Julian Garcia earning the win.

Injuries and availability are impacting several teams. Toronto Blue Jays right-handed pitcher Trey Yesavage has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left knee inflammation. Washington Nationals right fielder James Wood has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left oblique strain. The Athletics have also placed left-handed pitcher Jeffrey Springs on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 1, 2026, due to right hip discomfort, and first baseman Nick Kurtz on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 1, 2026, with a strained right thumb.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Athletics acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for outfielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels suffered a 3-1 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, dropping their game. Tyler O'Neill led the Orioles' offense with a home run, his eighth of the season.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians 6-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 6.0 innings pitched. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Athletics in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 5-4 victory over the Athletics, with Julian Garcia earning the win. Brady Singer led the Athletics' pitching effort, throwing 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Phillies in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals were defeated by the Philadelphia Phillies with a final score of 5-0. Jesús Luzardo earned the win for the Phillies, pitching 8.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays RHP Trey Yesavage Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right-handed pitcher Trey Yesavage has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left knee inflammation.

top_news.title: **Johnson Joins Athletics in Trade**
top_news.summary: Seth Johnson, a right-handed pitcher, was traded to the Athletics on August 3, 2026. He was acquired in exchange for outfielder Colby Thomas.
